name: Reijou Marie ~Boshi Jutai Bansankai~
original_name: 令嬢マリー～母子受胎晩餐会～
source:
Beginning of the 19th century, Maria Eruban, the only daughter of the house of the Baron Eruban, loses her father to disease. Her mother has already passed away, and she remains in the mansion with Charlotte, the second wife of her deceased father, and Ellis her daughter.

After her father is gone, fear has taken over Maria as there are no ties of blood with Charlotte. So Maria began to orchestrate something, however the mother and daughter.... 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=42981]Getchu[/url]]
